regimeSub: 10Y breaches 4.79% as Warsh hike odds harden pre-NFP, Brent clears $95 on Iran war premium.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole hawkish signal (Aug 28) continues to reprice September hike → 10Y at 4.79% (+1bp) as CNBC notes Fed 'at odds with Treasury' (Aug 31); Trump endorses Warsh 'doing what he has to do' (PBS Aug 31)

Iran war supply shock persists: Brent $95.69 (+$0.18) with WTI $91.24 → jdsupra (Sep 1) calls it 'new shock to global trade'; gold $4459 (+$98) as dual inflation/geopolitical hedge bid intensifies per Indian bond rout (ET Sep 2)

BOK Governor Rhee decoupling intact: 3.00% rate after back-to-back hikes (Aug 27) with 3.3% growth forecast → KRW firms to 1358 (-11) as Businesskorea (Aug 31) quotes BOK 'won't automatically follow US rate moves'

HBM rivalry rotation: Samsung gains vs SK Hynix slide (Seoul Economic Daily Sep 1) → KOSPI rallies to 6652 (+29) as AI memory stocks bid post-Nvidia earnings (Mitrade Sep 1); Nikkei hits 64455 on BOJ hike delay speculation

headline: Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole stance pushes 10Y to 4.79% as markets await Friday NFP with September hike now base case, while Iran war keeps Brent above $95 and gold surges to $4459 on stagflation hedging.
